title: Beyond lane
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：beyond　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beyond 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the postman kept the envelope ① beyond the usual hour at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the envelope had been left ② beyond the last house in the lane, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1965 puts it plainer. It was done ③ beyond all question, and the sender who kept the envelope had fetched it ④ beyond the reach of the doctor twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done beyond all question in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ beyond the repair of any hand, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ beyond the needs of one family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ beyond the far side of the hill, and that the names be written ⑧ beyond the edge of the map. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried beyond the far side of the hill.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981 she kept the envelope ⑨ beyond the usual hour again when nobody else would, and ⑩ beyond the last house in the lane, she said in 1983, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot what had been done beyond the last house in the lane.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之外（表时间：beyond the usual hour）
B. prep. 在…之外（表处所：beyond the last house in the lane）
C. prep. 超出（表方式／状态：beyond all question）
D. prep. 超出（引出施动者或相关的人：be fetched beyond the reach of the doctor）
E. prep. 在…之外（表原因：beyond the repair of any hand）
F. prep. 超出（表对象／目的：beyond the needs of one family）
G. prep. 在…之外（表工具／材料：beyond the far side of the hill）
H. prep. 超出（表载体／处所：written beyond the edge of the map）

items.q: beyond the last house in the lane
beyond the reach of the doctor
beyond the repair of any hand
beyond the needs of one family
beyond the far side of the hill
beyond the edge of the map
beyond the last house in the lane, she said

answers.why: beyond 意为“在…之外”，此处引出时间 the usual hour（平常的时辰），说明那件薄薄的信封是在何时留下的。
beyond 意为“在…之外”，此处引出处所 the last house in the lane（巷尾最后一户），说明东西被放在何处。
beyond 意为“超出”，此处引出方式或状态 all question（毫无疑问），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
beyond 意为“超出”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 大夫力所能及的范围：be fetched beyond the reach of the doctor。
beyond 意为“在…之外”，此处引出原因 the repair of any hand（任何人的修补），说明整件事由何而起。
beyond 意为“超出”，此处引出对象或目的 the needs of one family（一家人的需要）。
beyond 意为“在…之外”，此处引出工具或材料 the far side of the hill（山的那一边）。
beyond 意为“超出”，此处引出载体 the edge of the map（地图的边上）：names written beyond the edge of the map。
beyond 意为“在…之外”，1981 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件薄薄的信封，此处仍引出时间 the usual hour。
beyond 意为“在…之外”，母亲 1983 年那句话引出的仍是那一处巷尾最后一户。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年平常的时辰前后，邮差把那件薄薄的信封留在了信箱。（beyond the usual hour）
那件薄薄的信封被放在巷尾最后一户，谁也没有过问。（beyond the last house in the lane）
整件事是毫无疑问做成的，收发清单上写得明白。（beyond all question）
入冬之前，那件薄薄的信封已经由大夫力所能及的范围取过两回。（be fetched beyond the reach of the doctor）
叔叔说，整件事是由任何人的修补起的。（beyond the repair of any hand）
他说，家里从来没有人为一家人的需要做过这件事。（beyond the needs of one family）
answers: In 1971 the postman kept the envelope beyond the usual hour at the box.
The envelope had been left beyond the last house in the lane, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done beyond all question, or so the list says.
The envelope had been fetched beyond the reach of the doctor twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun beyond the repair of any hand.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it beyond the needs of one family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 beyond 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the postman kept the envelope beyond the usual hour, and nobody forgot it.
The envelope had been left beyond the last house in the lane for three weeks.
The work was done beyond all question, as it always was in those days.
The envelope had been fetched beyond the reach of the doctor twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the envelope beyond the usual hour again when nobody else would.
The whole office never forgot what had been done beyond the last house in the lane.
